about.title: Make the work clear. Make the system hold.
about.lead: I’m Aref Bahadori, a graphic designer working on identity, packaging, and digital product stories. I’m based in Fort Worth, Texas, and work with teams in the U.S. and Iran.
about.timeline: Eight years, one question: how does the idea work in the real world?
about.philosophy: A strong identity has to do more than look good in a presentation. It should stay recognizable on a small label, help people find their way around a product family, and carry one clear point of view from shelf to screen.
about.tools: Illustrator, Photoshop, Figma, Adobe XD, After Effects, Premiere, Blender, SketchUp, and InDesign.
